notes: Corrected: s014 is tagged R, the preposition 'et (H854) 'with', not the object marker H853, so its with is an ordinary prepositional rendering (rules 11, 16) and the earlier note's rule 16 analysis and added competing reading are withdrawn. Units, edges and heads are unchanged.
The it of Then did I eat it answers to no morpheme: the Sh token is a cohortative he, so the pronoun is added under rules 30 and 44.
Both articles of ha-megillah ha-zzot are unrepresented; the demonstrative s018 licenses the single this the ASV writes.
